title: An interrupted stream read preserves bytes already copied
summary: An interrupted empty read now throws with the interrupt flag set and cancels the source. A bulk read preserved three bytes at offset one before the next read threw.

change.description: The bridge from a publisher to an InputStream now distinguishes interruption before and after a bulk read has copied data. It preserves the thread's interrupt status.

notes: The controlled publisher stays open. A bounded reader observes the parent's continued wait, then sends completion and joins it. No competing byte is emitted.
